text:
Vivian Park: dropping a review thread for the 'replay + diff peek' idea on the rollout timeline. goals: let users time-travel a playback of traffic shifts, surface a compact diff peek between checkpoints, and design an accessible scrubber with minimal verbosity. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/replay/replay-rollouts
Arjun Desai: love the replay concept. one concern: if we animate traffic changes, SR users shouldn't get flooded with announcements. propose an option: 'Play (visual only)' vs 'Play (announce steps)'.
Marta Kim: +1. Also copy suggestion: call the feature 'Replay' in the toolbar but in settings use 'Playback announcements' toggle to be explicit.
Vivian Park: UX flow: click a checkpoint, press 'Replay from here' -> timeline plays increments (configurable speed) and shows a tiny diff peek card between each step that lists changed variants and delta %. want thoughts on the card content.
Arjun Desai: diff peek card should be short: variant letter + short label + delta (e.g., "A Canary +10% -> 40%") and an indicator if this step involved rollback/rollforward. keep to one line.
Marta Kim: accessibility: when replay is running and 'announce steps' is on, SR announcements should be concise, e.g., "Replay step 3 of 7: Canary A +10% (canary)". use aria-live="polite" and throttle announcements to avoid overlaps.
A11y Bot: guidance: include a user setting persisted per-org for default announce preference. For scrubber manual moves, emit single phrase per stop: "History: May 04, 2026  staged 15% to Canary A (active)". For replay with announce, prefix with step count as Marta suggested.
Ops Bot: backend note: traffic vesting curve previews will require simulated traffic numbers. we can provide estimated request counts but label them as "simulated". UX needs to show that distinction.
Vivian Park: good call. on the diff peek card we'll add a tiny badge: "simulated" when numbers are estimates. also show a confidence ribbon if metric signals exist (e.g., latency/regression) but hide by default for performance.
Arjun Desai: interaction detail: when replay pauses on a step, the diff peek should stay visible and be keyboard-focusable with action buttons: 'Inspect', 'Promote to live', 'Close'. buttons must be reachable by Tab.
Marta Kim: wording for promote action: should be 'Roll forward to here' in menu and modal title 'Confirm roll forward'. modal body: 'This will make version vX.Y live. Audit note (optional):' primary 'Roll forward' secondary 'Cancel'. keep consistent with other dialogs.
Vivian Park: telemetry ask: track whether users use replay with announce on vs off. product wants this for adoption metrics. annotate in figma comments.
A11y Bot: screen reader examples for replay announce (short):
```
"Replay: step 2 of 5  Apr 10, 2026  Canary A +10% (canary)"
"Replay: step 4 of 5  Apr 08, 2026  Reverted to v2.9 (reverted)"
```
Keep punctuation minimal to reduce verbosity.
Arjun Desai: visual contrast nit: diff peek card needs higher bg contrast in dark mode. set token to meet 4.5:1 for text. also add borderline for high-visibility mode.
Marta Kim: mobile behavior: on <360px we should collapse diff peek into a bottom sheet to avoid obscuring the timeline. ensure the playback controls (play/pause/step back) are reachable and 44px min touch.
Vivian Park: analytics + undo: after a Roll forward via Inspect -> Promote, show ephemeral banner 'Rolled forward to vX.Y  Undo' with 25s timer. Undo should be keyboard focusable and announced via role='status' but not steal focus.
Ops Bot: confirm: audit note should be saved with history and exported in CSV for compliance. we will surface an export button in timeline settings.
Arjun Desai: small copy tweak: prefer 'Export history' > 'Download CSV' in settings to be clear.
PreviewBot: preview deployed for branch `replay-diffpeek` at sha 9ab4ef  preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/replay-diffpeek
Marta Kim: leaving Figma comments about the announce toggle wording and small spacing changes. will re-review once frames updated. :raised_hands:
